discovery_context:
WHY this is being descoped, not built: dev-team:architecture-lead investigated turn-budget enforcement this session and found the worker plugin (scripts/cmux/worker-plugin/hooks/hooks.json) ships exactly two hooks, Stop -> return-gate.sh and UserPromptSubmit -> gate-mode.sh. {"continue": false} can only interrupt a RUNNING agent loop, and both available hooks fire at moments where there is no running loop to interrupt (Stop fires after the loop already ended; UserPromptSubmit fires only at kickoff, which must never block, and at a human interjection, which per gate-mode.sh's own settled invariant must never be force-stopped either). A Stop-based counter's only observable delta over the EXISTING gate.max_blocks counter (scripts/cmux/return-gate.sh) is events it must not act on. Building a new PostToolUse hook to count real inner-loop turns was considered and rejected: it would count tool calls, not turns (unit mismatch), it duplicates the ALREADY-EXISTING parent-side runaway bound timeout_s (ladder.mjs:428, `now - Date.parse(record.created_at) > timeout_s * 1000`, computed from parent-written fields the worker cannot touch) with strictly worse trust properties (a worker-tree counter sidecar is worker-writable), and it would be the first per-call hook in the worker plugin, reopening the per-call-latency concern that already ruled out a similar hook once before.

Current exact code being changed: scripts/cmux/record.mjs:535-537 resolves max_turns from three sources in priority order: `const maxTurns = config.maxTurns !== undefined ? config.maxTurns : (resolved.max_turns !== undefined ? resolved.max_turns : roster.defaults.max_turns)` — config.maxTurns comes from a dispatch-time CLI arg, resolved.max_turns is the role's roster override (none set today), roster.defaults.max_turns is the roster-wide default (null in scripts/cmux/roster.default.json today, hence the field is currently always null and the emission below is already dead code, not merely risky). Line 577 stores it on the record: `max_turns: maxTurns,`. Lines 643-644 are the emission to delete: `if (record.max_turns !== null) { argv.push('--max-turns', String(record.max_turns)) }`.

What to add: at the point maxTurns is resolved (record.mjs:535-537), after computing it and before it's used, throw if it is not null: something like `if (maxTurns !== null) { throw new Error('max_turns is set to ' + maxTurns + ' but gate-side turn-budget enforcement is not implemented (see ADR-014 in architecture-notes.md) — the CLI --max-turns flag emission was removed as unreachable/unenforceable; use timeout_s to bound a runaway worker instead') }`. Then delete lines 643-644 entirely (buildArgv never emits the flag, period — this makes the mutation test at test/cmux-record.test.mjs:641-652 need rewriting per the acceptance criteria above, since its current second half explicitly expects the flag to appear for max_turns:20).

references/cmux-dispatch.md:57 current text: '**Fidelity notes:** pane workers inherit `CLAUDE.md`, project skills, and MCP servers (Agent-tool subagents do not). `maxTurns` is unenforceable on a pane interactively — there is no hard turn cap until the Phase-3 gate counter lands.' Replace the second sentence: the 'Phase-3 gate counter' promise is retracted (investigated and found unbuildable, not merely deferred) — state that the runaway/hang bound is timeout_s, and max_turns remains schema-present but is refused (not silently accepted) if ever set non-null, per ADR-014.

ADR-014 (recorded separately as a memory delta by this task, or already present if be-08-01/be-08-02 land in the same session — check .claude/dev-team/memory/architecture-notes.md before writing a duplicate entry): 'cmux pane mode has no turn budget, by mechanism, not by omission.'
